options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: computer_name
options.description: DNS Name of the associated Computer Account when the SMB server is joined to an Active Directory domain.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the SMB server in UTF-8 characters.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain name where SMB server is registered in Active Directory, if applicable.

options.name: is_standalone
options.description: Indicates whether the SMB server is standalone. I(true) - SMB server is standalone. I(false) - SMB server is joined to the Active Directory.

options.name: local_admin_password
options.description: Password for the local administrator account of the SMB server.

options.name: nas_server
options.description: Unique identifier/name of the NAS server to which the network interface belongs, as defined by the I(nas_server) resource type.

options.name: netbios_name
options.description: NetBIOS name is the network name of the standalone SMB server.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: smb_server_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the SMB server.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the SMB server should be enabled or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: workgroup
options.description: Windows network workgroup for the SMB server. Applies to standalone SMB servers only.
